const code = `import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange

set_option autoImplicit false
universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits
namespace AlgebraicGeometry
noncomputable section

noncomputable def testNested
    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    pullback (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≅
      pullback (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g := by
  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
  have he : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV := by
    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).fst = _
    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
  exact
    asIso (pullback.map
      (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV
      (pullback.snd g (iU ≫ f) ≫ iU) iV
      (pullbackSymmetry (iU ≫ f) g).hom (𝟙 V) (𝟙 X)
      (by simp) (by simp)) ≪≫
    pullbackAssoc g (iU ≫ f) iU iV ≪≫
    pullbackSymmetry g (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) ≪≫
    asIso (pullback.map
      (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) g
      (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g e.inv (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z)
      (by
        simpa only [Category.comp_id, Category.assoc] using
          congrArg (fun q => q ≫ iU ≫ f) he.symm)
      (by simp))

private noncomputable def testAux
    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : W ⟶ U) (e : W ≅ pullback iU iV)
    (he : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV) :
    pullback (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≅
      pullback (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g :=
    asIso (pullback.map
      (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV
      (pullback.snd g (iU ≫ f) ≫ iU) iV
      (pullbackSymmetry (iU ≫ f) g).hom (𝟙 V) (𝟙 X)
      (by simp) (by simp)) ≪≫
    pullbackAssoc g (iU ≫ f) iU iV ≪≫
    pullbackSymmetry g (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) ≪≫
    asIso (pullback.map
      (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) g
      (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g e.inv (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z)
      (by
        simpa only [Category.comp_id, Category.assoc] using
          congrArg (fun q => q ≫ iU ≫ f) he.symm)
      (by simp))

private theorem testAux_fst
    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : W ⟶ U) (e : W ≅ pullback iU iV)
    (he : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV) :
    (testAux iU iV f g a e he).hom ≫
        pullback.fst (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g ≫ a =
      pullback.fst (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≫
        pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g := by
  simp only [testAux, pullback.map, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom,
    Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst_assoc,
    pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst_assoc, he,
    pullbackAssoc_hom_snd_fst, pullback.lift_fst_assoc,
    pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_snd]

private theorem testAux_snd
    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V) (e : W ≅ pullback iU iV)
    (he : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV)
    (heb : e.inv ≫ b = pullback.snd iU iV) :
    (testAux iU iV f g a e he).hom ≫
        pullback.fst (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g ≫ b =
      pullback.snd (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV := by
  simp only [testAux, pullback.map, Iso.trans_hom, asIso_hom,
    Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst_assoc,
    pullbackSymmetry_hom_comp_fst_assoc, heb,
    pullbackAssoc_hom_snd_snd, pullback.lift_snd, Category.comp_id]

theorem test_fst
    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    (testNested iU iV f g a b hab hW).hom ≫
        pullback.fst (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g ≫ a =
      pullback.fst (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≫
        pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g := by
  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
  have he : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV := by
    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).fst = _
    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
  change (testAux iU iV f g a e he).hom ≫
      pullback.fst (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g ≫ a = _
  exact testAux_fst iU iV f g a e he

theorem test_snd
    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    (testNested iU iV f g a b hab hW).hom ≫
        pullback.fst (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g ≫ b =
      pullback.snd (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV := by
  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
  have hea : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV := by
    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).fst = _
    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
  have heb : e.inv ≫ b = pullback.snd iU iV := by
    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).snd = _
    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.right
  change (testAux iU iV f g a e hea).hom ≫
      pullback.fst (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g ≫ b = _
  exact testAux_snd iU iV f g a b e hea heb

#print axioms test_fst
#print axioms test_snd
end
end AlgebraicGeometry`;
